'''AF Elbasani''' ({{langx|sq|Akademia e Futbollit Elbasani}}), is an [[Albania|Albanian]] professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Elbasan]]. The club competes in the [[Kategoria Superiore]], the top tier of [[football in Albania|Albanian football]]. Their home ground is [[Elbasan Arena]]."}}
